review: T27-2 P4. T13 in_scope is energy-batch membership, not v1 machine closure. T16/T17/T18 batch dispositions are reviewed: implemented/selected/preimplemented kinds are v1_required closed; MAPPED_DEFERRED keeps a related_host descriptor without closing the kind; T13-only and T18 deferred kinds stay post_1_0. Machine kind, CC block and RecipeMap host stay separate. Reactors/massfab/replicator/ZPM/quantum stay Track C. Magic absorber stays post_1_0, not a VIS-energy exclusion.

in_scope.replacement_condition: A later 1.x machine card measures this canonical kind separately from any related RecipeMap host or existing CC block; presence of a block is not closure.

closure.evidence: T13 in_scope only means the kind sat in a T15-T18 energy batch. T27 does not treat that as a closed v1 machine.

fidelity.evidence: T13 machine_kinds canonical key. A live RecipeMap or CC block may belong to a different energy identity.

load.evidence: Unselected machine-kind load cannot be filled with 0.

deferred_with_reason.replacement_condition: A later 1.x card measures or excludes this energy/nuclear kind; T27 does not implement it.

closure.evidence: T13 deferred_with_reason machine kind. T27 keeps it post_1_0.

fidelity.evidence: T13 deferred machine kind plus T16-T18 energy-batch evidence.

load.evidence: Deferred machine-kind load cannot be filled with 0.

IMPLEMENTED_PRE_T16.replacement_condition: Not applicable: this canonical kind already has a selected or preimplemented CC host.

closure.evidence: T16 marks this kind IMPLEMENTED_PRE_T16. Kind-level v1 obligation is the selected host, not row-level map completion.

fidelity.evidence: T16 machine denominator plus T13 canonical key. RecipeMap leftover rows stay Track A.

load.evidence: Selected host already participates in the T26 READY publication; T27 adds no machines.

IMPLEMENTED_T16A.replacement_condition: Not applicable: T16a selected this canonical kind.

closure.evidence: T16a implemented this canonical kind. Existing block plus selected energy identity close the kind, not every source tier.

load.evidence: T16a host is on the T26 READY path; T27 adds no machines.

IMPLEMENTED_T16B.replacement_condition: Not applicable: T16b selected this canonical kind.

closure.evidence: T16b implemented Press as the selected KU kind.

load.evidence: T16b host is on the T26 READY path; T27 adds no machines.

IMPLEMENTED_T17A.replacement_condition: Not applicable: T17a selected this canonical kind.

load.evidence: T17a host is on the T26 READY path; T27 adds no machines.

PREIMPLEMENTED_REFERENCE.replacement_condition: Not applicable: a pre-T16/T17/T18 reference already hosts this kind.

closure.evidence: T16/T17/T18 marks this kind PREIMPLEMENTED_REFERENCE with a live CC host.

fidelity.evidence: Batch preimplemented reference plus T13 canonical key. A related map on another energy identity is a different kind.

load.evidence: Reference host is on the T26 READY path; T27 adds no machines.

SELECTED_T18.replacement_condition: Not applicable: T18 selected this converter/generator kind.

closure.evidence: T18 selected this energy machine kind and bound a converter profile.

fidelity.evidence: T18 machine energy denominator SELECTED_T18. An existing axle/gearbox is not a substitute for a different converter kind.

load.evidence: T18 converter is on the T26 READY path; T27 adds no machines.

MAPPED_DEFERRED.replacement_condition: A later card may adopt this energy-identity kind only after measuring it separately from the related_host block; the related host does not close this canonical key.

closure.evidence: A CC block/map exists, but T16/T17 classified this canonical kind MAPPED_DEFERRED because the live host uses a different energy identity or was not selected.

fidelity.evidence: T16/T17 MAPPED_DEFERRED plus related_host descriptor. Machine kind, CC block and RecipeMap host remain three identities.

load.evidence: Related-host presence is not a load measurement for this kind.

T13_ONLY_DEFERRED.replacement_condition: A later 1.x card must add a local map, energy identity and acquisition together; this kind must not be merged into an unrelated live host.

closure.evidence: T16/T17 T13_ONLY_DEFERRED: no local map and not selected.

fidelity.evidence: T13 canonical kind with no CC host in the selected batch.

load.evidence: Absent-family machine-kind load cannot be filled with 0.

DEFERRED_WITH_REASON.replacement_condition: A later energy/storage/generation card measures this T18 kind; T27 does not implement converters.

fidelity.evidence: T18 machine energy denominator deferred row.

load.evidence: Unselected T18 kind load cannot be filled with 0.

RM.Massfab.reason: Matter fabricator machine kind is Track C, not a default industrial post-1.0 card. The fusion_reactor multiblock kind remains out_of_scope.
